Elena —

Thanks — adding the evaluation plan and the SOW in this thread. I'm including Karthik (solutions & deployment) and Laura (CS onboarding) so they can confirm the technical acceptance criteria and the earliest feasible start date.

Evaluation highlights (summary):
- Test set: 120 representative prompts across search, recommendation, and merchandising flows
- Acceptance gates: 95% non-regression on latency (<350ms P95), quality threshold (QA-approved prompt pass-rate >= 88%), and security checks (no PII leakage in sampled outputs)
- Decision: go if all three gates pass on the staging evaluation run; fallback plan is a 1-week remediation window and a paired regression run.

SOW snapshot: we've set a targeted production start of 2026-10-20, 09:00 PT, contingent on signatures and final infra provisioning. If legal requires a longer review, we can shift start date to 10/27 — call this our contingency slot.

2) Confirm signer order for DocuSign so Ben can update route (Elena requested a technical->proc->legal->exec flow)
3) Signoff on evaluation acceptance criteria (above) or propose adjustments by 10/12 noon PT

I'll attach the evaluation plan and SOW in a follow-up message (they're slightly large).
